title: Dog Grooming Text Message Templates (Copy & Paste)

facts.fact: The PawScheduler page was last updated on November 3, 2026.
PawScheduler's free plan covers up to 50 appointments a month and does not require a credit card (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: The free plan covers up to 50 appointments a month. No credit card.

facts.fact: PawScheduler (vendor's own claim) sends automatic email confirmations and reminders on its Free and Basic plans, and texts from the business's own number on its Growth plan.
facts.quote: PawScheduler sends confirmations and reminders automatically (email on Free and Basic, texts from your own business number on Growth)

facts.fact: The vendor recommends a common reminder setup of one reminder 24 to 48 hours before an appointment.
facts.quote: A common setup is one reminder 24 to 48 hours before

facts.fact: For mobile groomers, the vendor suggests sending a short reminder the morning of the appointment.
facts.quote: a short message the morning of the appointment

facts.fact: The page states that business texts to clients in the US and Canada require the client's consent.
facts.quote: Yes. For business texts in the US and Canada you need the client's consent

facts.fact: The page advises including "Reply STOP to opt out" in reminder texts.
facts.quote: include "Reply STOP to opt out" in reminders

facts.fact: The vendor advises giving clients at least 30 days' notice before a price increase takes effect.
facts.quote: Give at least 30 days' notice, keep the message short and thankful

facts.fact: The page advises that appointments already booked before a price increase should stay at the current price.
facts.quote: Appointments already booked before then stay at the current price.

facts.fact: The page recommends that groomers keep a record of which clients agreed to receive texts.
facts.quote: Ask on your intake form or booking page, and keep a record of who said yes.

facts.fact: The page's appointment reminder template is labeled for sending 1 to 2 days before the appointment.
